description: icgc.cat: coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by icgc.cat. Coverage: the area served by icgc.cat. The listing groups 20 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about coastal flood and storm surge hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Línea de costa v1.0 - Octubre-Noviembre 2024; Línea de costa v1.0 - Octubre-Noviembre 2015; Línea de costa v1.0 - Temporal diciembre 2019; Línea de costa v1.0 - Octubre-Noviembre 2025. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.ca). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
